invariants.rationale: Methods returning metadata objects typically do not return null; a valid HoodieWriteMetadata is constructed and returned.
logCompactionInstantTime is passed directly into constructors and methods, indicating that it is expected to be non-null.
context is used directly; a null context would likely cause failures. Nullness is a valid invariant here.
getWriteStatuses() should return a valid list representing write statuses; a null would indicate a failure in compaction.
After log compaction, at least one WriteStatus is expected to be returned.
